assets.name: slash
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite sheet for Mysterious Hearts RPG combat VFX. EXACTLY 6 sequential animation frames in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, reading left to right then top to bottom. Landscape canvas 1536x1024, six equal square cells. No gutters, borders, labels, letters, numbers, UI, people, scenery or watermarks. Uniform dark slate #101824 background across entire sheet. Fixed camera, consistent scale, each effect entirely inside the central 70% of its cell, no crossing cell edges. Polished hand-painted anime game effects, crisp silhouettes and restrained glow. This sheet will be sliced into six 80ms frames for a finite combat effect; do not draw multiple motion states inside any one cell. Frame 1 small anticipation; frame 2 builds; frame 3 strongest; frame 4 disperses; frame 5 fades; frame 6 nearly gone. One pale steel-blue physical blade crescent swings from lower left to upper right. Start a short curved sliver; grow the sweep; one broad clean crescent at peak; break into three thin streaks; fade. No weapon, magic, electricity or impact explosion.
